_readme: Copy to config.json and edit. RepoHunter scores each repo's relevance against YOUR project profile, runs the LLM dossier through whatever backend you pick, and never needs any specific vendor.

project.name: My Project
project.profile: Describe your project in a few sentences: what it is, its stack, its goals and constraints, and what kinds of tools/libraries would help it. RepoHunter uses this to judge how relevant each repo is TO YOU.

llm._note: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Default: local Ollama (no API bill). For OpenAI/OpenRouter set base_url + api_key_env. For the Claude CLI set backend to 'claude-cli'.

_seed_note: Real starter repos so your first `refresh` shows something. Replace with repos relevant to YOUR project. Add "featured": true to any to auto-run the full LLM dossier on it.

seed.why: Run models locally — RepoHunter's default brain.
A clean CLI for talking to LLMs — a model reuse-first project.
Reference MCP servers your agents can adopt.
The downloader RepoHunter itself reuses for video ingest.
A fast Python linter/formatter — a compiled tool that runs anywhere.
